acquire.definition: max over accepted support sets E of |observed_evidence intersect E| / |E|
acquire.eligible: at least one independently accepted support set exists; provisional pre-promotion output must be labeled hypothesis_conditioned
acquire.name: Evidence Recall

acquire.definition: 1 iff at least one accepted support set is a subset of acquired citable evidence
acquire.name: All-Evidence Success

acquire.definition: best-match recall against modality sets induced by counterfactually validated acceptable support sets
acquire.eligible: only modalities with validated necessity; machine routing hypotheses are excluded
acquire.name: Modality Recall

act.definition: supported final success with valid trajectory and unchanged family budget
act.eligible: all systems with a budgeted run
act.name: Success@Budget

act.definition: stop with insufficient observed evidence while a certified route remains feasible under remaining cost/steps and no valid budget guard/recovery declaration applies
act.name: Premature Stop

act.definition: after a valid exact RESTORED trigger, acquire an acceptable support set and supportedly finalize within the unchanged remaining budget
act.eligible: recoverable BLOCKED-to-RESTORED family, trigger fires, feasible post-trigger route exists
act.name: Recovery

metrics.alternative_support_rule: Score against any independently accepted support set or registered claim-evidence entailment plus temporal overlap; never require only one preferred clip.

ground.definition: all required structured claims correct, no forbidden/contradictory claims
ground.name: Answer Score

ground.definition: harmonic mean of claim-level citation precision and required-claim citation recall across alternative acceptable derivations
ground.eligible: registered claim-evidence support and citable observations exist
ground.name: Citation F1
ground.zero_rule: eligible answer with no required citation scores zero; structurally ineligible is null

metrics.low_n_rule: LOW_N_NO_INFERENCE when eligible_family_count < 5 or eligible_source_count < 3; descriptive bootstrap intervals may be shown but no significance/ranking claim.
metrics.necessity_boundary: No necessity or minimality metric may consume Task 84 machine hypotheses as validated gold.

scientific_boundaries: Machine-adjudicated provisional evidence is not human-validated gold.
Candidate modality role is not validated necessity.
Candidate support set is not a minimal sufficient evidence set until counterfactual and independent-validator gates pass.
A bounded reviewed-window pool is not full long-video retrieval.
Metadata-only replay is not real-A/V evaluation.
Deterministic protocol probes cannot support model-quality or SOTA claims.
External compatibility results cannot be pooled with public-core results.
No raw media, transcript text, restricted prediction, or derivative may be publicly released under the current gate.
